paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: permanent Delete-session action for the session menu (DSH only ships archive)
# @mi-lu-uncle/dsh-session-delete
English | 简体中文 | 日本語
Adds a **Delete session** action to the session "…" menu of DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` only ships **archive** (a soft delete: hidden, but all data is kept). This plugin f
ills the gap — one click **permanently deletes** a session together with its on-disk data.
## Features
- In the session row's "…" menu, right after the built-in Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive, a new **Del

ete session** entry appears.
- Clicking it opens a confirmation dialog (showing the session title);

confirming invokes the host-side delete.
- Deleting cleans up three data locations:
1. The session i

tself: `~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/`
2. The projection cache: `~/.dsh/storages/session

_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json`
3. The session's registration in the workspace index (`sessio

nIds` / archive / pin marks)
- After a successful delete, the open UI **needs no refresh** — the row

disappears via the `api-session/removed` event.
- **Rebuilds the default workspace registration**:
If the default workspace was deleted, the plugin recreates its registration using `defaultWorkspaceI
d` or the last remembered path and attempts to reattach its sessions. It leaves other deleted worksp
aces alone. DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 exposes no public API to reset a dangling `defaultWorkspaceId`, so this c
annot guarantee full restoration of default-workspace behavior.
## Safety
- **Running sessions refuse deletion**: it uses the same `workspace/session-activity` detection as D
SH's archive. Only genuinely running work (an in-flight conversation turn, background jobs, …) is bl
ocked with "this session is running"; idle old sessions (even if still kept alive in DSH's memory) d

elete normally.
- Deletion goes through DSH's own workspace-registry write paths (`detachSession` /

`unarchiveSession` / `unpinSession`), so persisted state stays consistent.
- Routes are same-origin
fenced; only requests coming from the DSH UI itself are accepted.
## Install
This plugin targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` and newer `0.2.x` releases (currently verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`)
, and is linked into the `desktop` profile as a local directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then **restart DSH** for it to take effect.
You can also edit `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` manually:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart DSH.
## Usage

1. In the session list on the left, hover a session and click its "…".
2. Choose **Delete session**.
3. Click **Delete** in the confirmation dialog.
> ⚠️ Deletion is **permanent and irreversible**. Make sure the session really is no longer needed.
## Limitations / notes
- This is a community plugin built on DSH's public extension points (the session-menu slot `sidebar.
workspaces.session.menu.item` plus host-side file/registry cleanup). If a future DSH release ships a

n official "delete session" API, prefer that.
- Running sessions refuse deletion; if you really need

one gone, stop it first (finish/archive its work) and then delete.
- The full-text search index is
a rebuildable read model of DSH's; right after a delete there may be briefly stale results until the
read model of DSH's; right after a delete there may be briefly stale results until the next rebuild.
